answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy works when joining requires a durable lotus of scarce work that peers can audit: each identity must emit a consistent forge of attestations and graded answers across rounds, so cloning many accounts multiplies real cost instead of minting free votes. A careful prism through reciprocity-weighted panels then ejects empty twins, because they cannot keep matching the density of established non-kin checks without burning compute and stake.
